title: UPDATE needs a SELECT policy and the new row must pass it (correctness matrix)
issue: UPDATE/INSERT ... RETURNING/ON CONFLICT read the row, so SELECT policies apply to the existing row and, as an extra WITH CHECK, to the new row. No SELECT policy = UPDATE silently affects 0 rows; a SELECT policy of `NOT deleted AND ...` makes a soft-delete UPDATE fail with 'new row violates row-level security policy'.
symptom: A correctness scenario: latencies are irrelevant. Look at the result-consistency section and per-query errors. naive_rls_no_select_policy: UPDATE/DELETE/upsert affect 0 rows and INSERT ... RETURNING errors. naive_rls (SELECT policy has NOT deleted): soft_delete errors. best_practice_rls matches the baseline for all statements.
